title: Rooftop jet route to roof loot
brief: Single change: plan a jet/jump climb onto a roof (≤ ~60 m reachable with 100 energy, protocol.md:282-287) to take crates/loot that spawn on roofs (about a quarter of them), when no enemy is in view and the zone allows. The champion's nav is ground-only (nav.ts:16-17); jets are used only as a stuck escape (brain.ts:875-877). It must be separate from B125's TAC_JET_LOOT (site 3.50 bundled pack): explain how it differs. Early activation count first (stop under 10/192), then the full BUILD_CHECKLIST, with a flag-ON head.
source: mechanics research directive (Doug 8:06 PM ET), coord/next-doug.md 5404931
decision: Recorded 8:18 PM ET per Doug: build after P38. Built and checklist-passed by Mech Builder; not submitted.
behaviors: Roof jet route: where the champion would only hold (or its farm/loot goal is itself on a roof) and farmOk holds, from t >= 10 s with no supply drop called or on the map and no drop run/ring hold, walk to the ground beside the roof item's wall, jump and jet onto the roof, and take the crate (broken by the existing farm shot), cube or wanted weapon.
sha_note: flag-ON head = the commit after this record update that only flips ROOF_JET_ROUTE_ON to true (byte-identical to /tmp/p40-on); printed by the builder as PUSHED <sha>
champion_note: champion P29 (code 2e1d036 merged as main b6f2f8b, site 4.35, MIDRING_SETTLE_ON=true). Comparison runs used origin/main 8f0ca4c, whose bot code (*.ts, package.json) is identical to b6f2f8b. Activation counts in this record are re-counted on this champion (none carried over from the old champion).
hook: brain.ts:915-1010, the 'Roof jet route (P40)' block, placed after the movement mode chain (farm/loot target choice ends brain.ts:907-914) and right before the midring settle (brain.ts:1011). It overrides only mode 'hold', or 'farm, hunt'/'farm, pickup'/'loot' when that goal is itself on a roof (or a climb is already in the air). Helpers onRoof/openGround/roofBase at brain.ts:474-515; constants brain.ts:156-175 and params.ts:160-179; state brain.ts:335-341.
differs_from_B125: B125 (PR #135, ec50d23, site 3.50 BB-C6A19503, CLOSE) bundled six flags (TAC_SPACE_EARLY, TAC_FIRE_MOVE, TAC_DODGE, TAC_JET_LOOT, TAC_LASER_REACH, TAC_FINISH_AMMO) on the old 4.17 main, so jet loot was never measured alone. Its TAC_JET_LOOT was a reactive hop on goals the old champion had already picked (a laser/lightning rush target, or a farm cube/drop in view within 80 m) that had no ground path or sat >= 4 m up: follow the ground route to 12 m, go straight at it, jump at any edge above step_up and jet until the feet clear it, with no target choice of its own, no roof crates, no memory, no climb spot, no energy wait, no t >= 10 s gate and no drop gate. P40 is one flag on the P29 champion with its own target choice: roof crates (none in B125), roof cubes and wanted roof weapons, remembered after they leave view, chosen only where the champion would hold (or its own goal is on a roof); it plans a climb spot on open ground beside the building wall (16-bearing edge search, no taller block between), walks there on a nav path, waits for 1.75 energy per metre + 15 (max 48 m), jets the full wall height, then stands by a crate while the existing farm shot breaks it; gated t >= 10 s, farmOk, no drop called or on the map, no drop run or ring hold; per-phase 3 s no-progress give-up, wait/crate/trip caps and a skip list.
drop_gate: PLAIN gate built (no supply drop called or on the map, plus no drop run / ring hold). First activation run (narrow-gated build, base 0 + 1000): narrow 15/192 games, plain 13/192 (activation ticks with obs.drops empty). Plain >= 10/192, so per the Coordinator drop-gate rule the plain gate is this build's single behavior. Confirmed on the plain-gated build: 13/192 (8 + 5).
